Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: multiple teams asked for one clear rule-of-thumb about credits vs quotas vs temporary burst increases during launches. Can we put a short, practical answer in the console?

Samir (VP Product): Rule-of-thumb: credits = money only; quotas/reserved capacity = throughput & SLA; burst = short-lived token-bucket on top of quotas. For anything larger than the burst window submit a Launch Support request with expected window + peak RPS.

Jamie (Finance): Important detail: promotional credits expire and never change quota metadata. If a deal includes guaranteed throughput, that must be in the contract (reserved capacity) and signed by Sales + Legal.

Riley (Support): For the Launch Support form include: account ID, start/end (tz), peak RPS, affected routes, SDK/language, and fallback plan. Use the console shortcut so it routes to on-call + SalesOps.

Ivy (Eng): SDK guidance: obey 429 + Retry-After and cap retries to 3 with exponential backoff + jitter. Streaming consumes tokens differently; note in the form whether traffic is streaming vs discrete requests.

OpsBot: System note: default per-account write QPS = 90 req/s, burst token-bucket = +25% for 45s. Temp quota API: POST /admin/temp_quota_request -> returns request_id and requires approver.

Samir (VP Product): Action items: Maya will add a one-liner FAQ in the console, Riley will add a canned support response, Jamie will draft the billing blurb, and Eng will add a short SDK retry example. Target: next Tue.

Ava (CEO): Thanks. Keep the console blurb super short (one sentence + link to form). Closing this thread unless objections. :rocket:
